name: herdr-tower
description: Control-tower operating protocol for a herdr agent fleet — dispatch from a spec file, watch a marker, verify independently, staff only the required seats
notes: Only two files are synced, both from the canonical upstream repo herdrdev/herdr on master: the README and herdr's own bundled agent skill (skills/herdr/SKILL.md), which is the authority on the CLI contract, ID semantics, and lifecycle states. Everything else in docs/ is AUTHORED, not synced, and has no upstream to sync from: dispatch.md, watch-and-poke.md, staffing.md, layout.md, closing.md, work-graph.md, and pitfalls.md distil the operating protocol of a private control tower (its CLAUDE.md, herdr-fleet and work-graph skills, docs/staffing.md, docs/org-model.md, and bin/tower-watch.sh + bin/tower-poke.sh, ported here under scripts/). docs/cli-reference.md is authored from the installed binary and was verified against herdr 0.7.5 — re-check it against `herdr --help` on sync rather than fetching it, since herdr publishes no per-command reference page. Note that herdrdev/herdr also carries the CLI docs only as a JSON socket-API schema (docs/next/api/herdr-api.schema.json) plus the herdr.dev website, neither of which is a useful Markdown sync target.
